page1_s6.raw_text: The coverages, limits and policy period shown apply only if you pay for this policy to renew. Your coverage begins on August 11, 2026 at 12:01 a.m. This policy expires on February 11, 2027 at 12:01 a.m. Your insurance policy and any policy endorsements contain a full explanation of your coverage. The policy contract is form 9611A NY (09/22). The contract is modified by form A403 NY (11/23).

page4_s3.raw_text: Thanks for being a Progressive customer since February 11, 2002; renew your policy today and enjoy Crown Loyalty Rewards.

page4_s4.raw_text: Enclosed are your policy documents and ID cards. Your current policy period ends August 11, 2026 at 12:01 a.m. This renewal offer is for the policy period August 11, 2026 through February 11, 2027. Your 6-month policy premium excluding billing fees and payment option discounts is $693.00.
